facts.label: The more, the better
facts.sub: Use the + comparativo, the + comparativo para mostrar que uma coisa muda com a outra: The bigger the bag, the better the price. Use much ou far antes de um comparativo.

facts.label: Quanto mais, melhor
facts.sub: Use the + comparativo, the + comparativo para dizer que uma coisa muda com a outra: The more we buy, the cheaper it is. Com adjetivo curto, use -er: the bigger, the better.

facts.label: Mais forte
facts.sub: Antes de um comparativo, use much, far ou a lot para uma diferença grande: It’s much cheaper. It’s far better. Use a little ou slightly para uma diferença pequena.

items.s: The more, the better means a growing result.

Much cheaper is stronger than cheaper. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “the more big, the better”. → Falso (We say the bigger, the better.)

pages.title: The supermarket · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in a big supermarket in Toronto. Fern pushes the cart and Tom carries a list. The shop is full of people and colorful fruit. Prices are different from last week. Fern wants to save money this month. She compares every product carefully.
“Tom, look at these apples. They’re much cheaper than last week.” says Fern. “Great! The more we buy, the cheaper they are.” says Tom. “The bigger the bag, the better the price, right?” says Fern.
